title: Saudi Arabian Chicken Tagine Casserole
description: A fusion of Middle Eastern and Chinese flavors, this dish combines the rich taste of Saudi Arabian tagine with the comfort of a Chinese casserole.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Arabian tagine spice blend and cook for an additional minute.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the funky rice, aerated vegetable broth, casserole mix, saudi dates, and chopped scallions.
Stir in the cooked chicken and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Note: If using store-bought casserole mix, follow package instructions for additional ingredients and cooking time.
